Trestle's RESO Web API is an OData 4.0 / RESO Web API 2.0 compliant endpoint that delivers MLS Property, Member, Office, Media, OpenHouse, Teams, and related real-estate resources across multiple aggregated U.S. MLSs. Authentication uses OAuth2 Client Credentials against api.cotality.com/trestle/oidc/connect/token with scope=api; tokens are valid for 8 hours. Conforms to the RESO Data Dictionary 2.0.
